description: Get the link to connect a new social media account (instagram, facebook, threads, linkedin, tiktok, twitter, youtube, pinterest, bluesky, telegram, mastodon, google-business) to Schedulala. google-business uses OAuth via the dashboard/connect URL like the other OAuth platforms (Google consent screen, then pick business locations). The link opens the Schedulala dashboard where the user completes the platform's own sign-in in their browser; credentials and OAuth approval NEVER happen in this chat. Use when the user wants to add or reconnect a platform. After they finish, call list_accounts to confirm the new account is connected.

platform.description: Optional platform to give targeted instructions for. Omit for the general connect link.

name: connect_account
title: Connect a Social Account
